name: image-converter
title: Image Converter & Compressor: WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG
description: Convert and compress images to WebP, AVIF, JPEG or PNG: resize, set quality or a target size in KB, strip EXIF. Reads HEIC, TIFF, BMP, GIF and SVG. Input: image URLs, key-value store uploads or a dataset field. Output: file links with bytes saved. $0.002 per image.
